name: Tinkerer Club
author: Derek Neighbors
description: Tinkerer Club feed in the Omarchy bar: recent posts, articles, and a one-click jump into the club.

barWidget.description: Read the Tinkerer Club feed from the bar

schema.label: API key file
schema.description: File that contains your Tinkerer Club member API key on one line. Empty uses ~/.config/omarchy/secrets/tinkerer-club-api-key. Keep the key out of this repo and out of shell.json.

schema.label: Platform URL
schema.description: HTTPS origin for the Tinkerer Club API. Leave the default unless the club gave you another endpoint.

schema.label: Feed items
schema.description: How many recent posts and notifications to pull for the first page.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.

schema.label: Quiet refresh every
schema.description: Minutes. The bar uses this only to notice new activity. Opening the panel always fetches the current feed.
